statement: SystemTableCache exposes an accepted per-key CDC observation bound to the cached row origin HLC; causally older, backfill-only, authoritative, hydration, delete, and unrelated-key mutations cannot advance or impersonate that evidence.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Observation provenance is owned by SystemTableCache per table key, derives origin HLC from the accepted row rather than the receiver-reminted envelope, and is exposed read-only.

This child may add diagnostic provenance only; it cannot change CDC conflict resolution, merge, tombstone, hydration, authoritative replacement, listener notification, schema watermark, or readiness outcomes.
Causally older or backfill-only CDC cannot advance provenance; accepted non-CDC replacement, origin mismatch, delete, anti-entropy removal, and clear invalidate it.
